## Verdict

PASS. No blocker, high, or medium correctness defect remains in the pre-implementation architecture. The revision supplies the missing value-only reservation locus, keeps MainActor off all locks and synchronous queue waits, preserves one immutable request/deadline from admission through raw claim, and orders cancellation, raw cleanup, terminal events, and later authority without weakening the earlier deadline, output-boundary, focus, Return-routing, or async speech-topology contracts.

## Correctness R5 closure

- `ReviewSubmissionAdmissionEnvelope` now carries the exact opaque handle, immutable request descriptor, and once-computed absolute deadline. The MainActor-confined ticket issuer uses the control-plane nonce plus a checked never-reused counter, stores the handle/envelope before the first nonblocking enqueue, and fails closed on overflow without touching a lock, raw object, target registry, or background queue (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:245-316`).
- The local `admissionPending/currentHandle` fence rejects duplicate real gestures before enqueue. The independent control-plane store admits at most one active `ReservedAttemptControlRecord`, so an injected duplicate envelope cannot mint a sibling permit; deadline time spent on both control and raw queues is preserved rather than renewed (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:318-334`).
- `ReservedAttemptControlRecord` is the explicit legal cross-thread reservation locus: nonce, never-reused ID, exact immutable descriptor, exact absolute deadline, phase, and cancellation bit. It contains no AX element, CGEvent, source, backend, closure, continuation, target-registry entry, or raw-state reference (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:336-356`). This resolves the ownership contradiction from R5.
- Admission, start, and cancellation invoked from MainActor enter one dedicated FIFO value-only control context through immediate-return `DispatchQueue.async` calls. MainActor waits on neither the commit lock nor either serial context. Start is enqueued only after matching acceptance and only while the same handle remains current and locally uncancelled (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:293-334`, `:685-729`).
- The raw executor receives only a handle, lock-claims the matching uncancelled `startQueued` record, copies its exact immutable descriptor/deadline, releases the lock, and then validates `capturedTargetID` against the serial-confined target registry before any AX setter, cursor restoration, event construction, or preparation. It accepts no replacement descriptor and never recomputes the deadline (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:374-387`, `:490-548`). Foreign, stale, never-admitted, cancelled, and wrong-phase handles therefore fail before raw work.
- Cancellation between admission and raw start terminalizes the unclaimed record on the control context with zero raw-executor work. After claim, the raw attempt checks the exact record after every synchronous return, before baseline, around preparation, during gate admission, and directly under the final lock before down (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:326-394`, `:549-569`).
- The production-composition selectors now verify descriptor/deadline preservation, pre-start cancellation, foreign/stale/wrong-phase rejection, occupied-raw-executor control-plane responsiveness, every pre-down cancellation ordering, stale-handle isolation, and post-down mandatory up plus MainActor heartbeat (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:921-980`, `:1021-1071`). The file ownership and build order assign both new confinement domains and shared types before coordinator integration (`:780-891`, `:1073-1094`).

## Prior finding regression check

- Correctness R1 remains closed. The single absolute monotonic deadline is created once at gesture consumption and covers control admission delay, raw queue wait, every AX object/message, monitor and baseline setup, modifier stabilization, event preparation/readback, bounded lock admission, and the under-lock comparison immediately before down. MainActor has no timeout authority that can race a live pair (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:645-683`).
- Correctness R2 remains closed. Send is not an AppKit default button and has no Return key equivalent. One preview-local native arbiter authorizes only exact unmodified, nonrepeating main Return or keypad Enter in the exact key panel; Shift/IME and all modified, repeated, or out-of-preview events yield zero confirmation. Native application-route tests cover Control plus Return and keypad Enter with zero intent, delivery, and output (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:731-779`, `:991-1019`).
- Correctness R3 remains closed. The only pre-RED production change is the output-owned behavior-preserving diagnostic seam; TDD then records the immediate non-hanging production-composition RED before any behavioral repair, and GREEN must use the concrete repaired epoch, control plane, executor, and committer (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:893-943`, `:1073-1094`).
- Correctness R4 remains closed. Exact-handle cancellation runs on the control context independently of occupied raw AX work, shares the final lock-linearization boundary with commit, checks before baseline/preparation/gate/down, retires raw post authority before terminal delivery, and cannot affect a later attempt through a stale handle (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:311-394`, `:540-589`). Cancellation after down remains advisory and cannot suppress mandatory up or authorize resend.
- Security R4's MainActor-lock regression is also closed. MainActor only enqueues cancellation; the control context alone may wait for the commit lock. A concrete post-down pause must prove close/Escape and repeated MainActor heartbeat continue while cancellation is pending, followed by mandatory up, terminal submitted-unverified, and no resend (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:685-729`, `:972-976`, `:1052-1061`).

## Other reviewed contracts

- Raw target capture, AX objects, event source/events, prepared pair, epoch baseline, and backend remain confined to the raw executor. Every newly created system-wide, application, focused, and captured AX object receives its own remaining-budget timeout before every message; fixed-target validation occurs before output work and never ambiently retargets (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:142-211`, `:490-503`).
- The state machine keeps recording/streaming and sealing read-only, requires final action 2 plus recorder barrier for the same generation before editable authority, and exposes only one visible preparing state over internal control/raw phases. A terminal event is applied only to the matching retained review/generation/revision/handle (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:40-63`, `:218-243`, `:428-476`).
- Preboundary failure restores the exact draft and preview focus only after pair/source destruction and control-record retirement. After the first down attempt, key-up is mandatory and synchronous, every outcome is submitted-unverified terminal, and ordinary Send/Return or automatic retry never returns (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:389-425`, `:565-589`, `:716-729`).
- FIFO cleanup ordering is complete: a claimed raw attempt marks `terminalizing`, destroys post-capable objects, and enqueues only a Sendable cleanup value; the control context processes earlier cancellation commands, retires the exact record, and only then emits terminal. The raw executor never waits on the control queue, and a retired handle cannot mutate the next record (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:389-394`, `:565-583`).
- The independent recorder and recognition transports remain protected; only reviewed authority handoff and lifecycle integration may change. Clipboard/Cmd+V, target activation, global Return, default-button Return, automatic retry, and ambient retargeting remain prohibited (`architecture-blueprint-v5.md:1154-1182`).
